value.basis: Lab four-choice RT with spatially compatible keys in young adults runs ~380-420 ms median; adding ~40-70 ms of browser/keyboard/display latency and unproctored online variability pushes the mean to ~450 ms, with between-person SD around 55-70 ms inflated slightly by device heterogeneity. The short 60-trial block with a median scorer keeps individual estimates fairly stable but leaves little room for fatigue effects.
